Enterprise Edition.note: Existing zh-TW UI renders the edition name as 企業版 in the About dialog; keep English when treated as a product name, 企業版 when the surrounding sentence is fully translated.

Team Edition.note: Existing zh-TW UI renders it as 團隊版 in the About dialog; same guidance as Enterprise Edition.

Channels.note: Product name; the common noun channel is 頻道.

System Console.note: Consistently used across existing zh-TW admin strings.

post.note: Existing zh-TW renders both 'post' and 'message' as 訊息; do not introduce a separate word such as 貼文.

reply.note: Noun and verb are identical in Chinese.

direct message.note: Established zh-TW rendering; note it uses 私人 even though 'private channel' is also 私人頻道 — context disambiguates.

mention.note: Noun and verb are identical; @mention → @提及.

pin.note: Majority rendering; a minority of strings use 置頂 (e.g. no_results.pinned_messages) — prefer 釘選 and converge.

saved messages.note: save → 儲存, unsave → 取消儲存.

reaction.note: User-facing strings use 反應 (新增反應, 反應上限); some admin/moderation strings use 互動 — prefer 反應.

away.note: Same word as the verb 'leave' (離開); availability context makes it clear.

session.note: Standard Taiwan term; do not use 會話 (Simplified convention).

sign in.note: Both 'sign in' and 'log in' map to 登入.

mute.note: Channel muting also uses 靜音 (靜音頻道 / 取消靜音頻道), same word as microphone mute in Calls.

favorite.note: Verb/menu action: 加入我的最愛 (Add to Favorites) / 從我的最愛中移除; standalone label sometimes shortened to 最愛.

slash command.note: Majority rendering (33 vs 3 for 斜線指令); keep 斜線命令.

webhook.note: Kept in English with capital W throughout existing zh-TW strings.

plugin.note: Established zh-TW rendering; do not use 外掛 or 插件.

role.note: Majority in existing zh-TW permission strings (授予的地位); 角色 is the standard Taiwan software term and also appears — flagging as an inconsistency worth converging on 角色 in a future cleanup.

scheme.note: Permission Scheme → 權限策略, System Scheme → 系統級策略, Team Override Scheme → 團隊級覆寫策略.

seat.note: Existing billing strings render '{n} seats' simply as '{n} 人'; keep that counting pattern, use 席次 only when a standalone noun is required.

trial.note: 試用版 for the trial license/edition, 試用期 for the trial period, per context.

deactivate.note: Also used for 'disable'; deactivated users occasionally rendered 停權 — prefer 停用.

urgent.note: One legacy priority label uses 急迫; related persistent-notification strings use 緊急 — prefer 緊急.

recap.note: Feature not yet translated in zh-TW; 重點回顧 chosen to avoid clashing with 摘要 (summary) and 回顧 (Playbooks retrospective).

agent.note: No existing zh-TW translation; Taiwan tech convention for AI agent is (AI) 代理. Keep 'Agents' in English where it names the plugin/product.

burn-on-read.note: Established Chinese term for self-destructing messages; not yet translated in zh-TW files.

magic link.note: Not yet translated in zh-TW files; 魔法連結 follows common Taiwan usage for passwordless email links.

channel banner.note: Not yet translated; follows 公告橫幅 (announcement banner) pattern.

profile.note: Majority rendering across webapp and mobile; 個人資料 also appears — prefer 個人檔案.

collapsed reply threads.note: Not yet translated in zh-TW; uses 摺疊 (collapse) per existing display-settings strings.

compliance export.note: 法遵 is the majority rendering for compliance (25 vs 12 for 合規).

access control.note: Standard Taiwan term; the attribute-based feature is not yet translated.

onboarding.note: Per existing 「新手上路」流程 strings.
